subject: MUPG

Through the study and discussion of both primary and secondary sources, students will observe and compare national styles. Special topics include the conventions of recitative; text-driven embellishment; ornamentation in Handel's dramatic works.

Approximately one-third of the class will be spent performing, critiquing and mentoring the performances of class members.

restrictions.text: Open to students in the Jazz Performance option and others with the permission of the instructor.
